title: Lookup dropdown
summary: Replace a lookup field with an accessible dropdown of configured target rows.
whyWanted: Lookup UX is the top community ask for PCF.
configuration: Bind lookupValue to a single-table lookup column, set targetTable to that lookup target table's logical name, optionally set selectableFilter to an OData filter such as the table's active-row predicate, then add this component from the modern form designer Components pane or the classic Controls tab.
